findings: Induction on m uses 2^(m+1)=2^m*2, mul_nsmul and the same transition hx(k+m); Nat.add_assoc matches the index exactly.
Uniform exponent bound annihilates x(k+N), so iterated transition gives every x(k)=0. No finite group hypothesis necessary; N=0 also valid for trivial group.
ZMod(2^N) is killed by its characteristic via nsmul_eq_mul and characteristic cast simplification; N=0 means ZMod1 and is valid.
A compatible infinite halving sequence is forced zero for bounded exponent. This does not assert all individual torsion points zero, nor vanishing of towers in the alternative Pruefer model.
No assumption of finite Sha, pointwise converse, module corank or duality. Sound finite-model prerequisite only; no local Lean or kernel acceptance.
